summary: Revisions 1 (PR #66), 2 (PR #67), and 3 (PR #68) were all closed without merging, so this task started from verified origin/main, reconstructed the sound revision-1 through revision-3 corrections (matching the already-reviewed content of the closed claude/relay-PP-RELAY-042-head-line-source-cleanup-r3 branch), and applied the required revision-4 remediation on top in one pass. Corrected the two Director-identified anonymous-authority/consensus overstatements in src/content/blog/beginner/head-line.md: the writer's-fork naming sentence generalized the verified fact that neither Cheiro nor Benham uses the label into an unsupported 'rather than one from the classical texts' chronology/classical-text-wide claim (narrowed to state only that neither Cheiro nor Benham uses the label); and the intelligence/IQ FAQ and myth wording ('The tradition says nothing about cognitive ability' / '...about IQ or cognitive ability') asserted an unsupported exhaustive tradition-wide consensus (restated as Palmistry Path's own bounded editorial interpretation: 'This article does not treat length as a measure of intelligence, IQ, or cognitive ability'). All sound revision-1 through revision-3 corrections were re-verified intact and unchanged, including the Director-verified Benham direction/path evidence boundary. Re-read both revision-4 passages for directly equivalent anonymous-authority/consensus wording; none remained. Independently re-reviewed all ten remaining claim-risk heuristic findings (unchanged count from revision 3) against the source-boundary checklist rather than carrying forward the revision-3 dispositions uncritically; all ten remain quoted text, this article's own editorial framing, or non-population statements, none within the scoped cleanup categories, and neither revision-4 edit location appears among them. Updated docs/source-verification-log.md with a full revision-4 claim-by-claim disposition and docs/CHANGELOG.md with revision-3 (never previously recorded on main) and revision-4 entries.

source_preflight.notes: Ran npm run audit:claim-risk against the final file (10 findings, unchanged from revision 3) and manually re-read the complete final article end to end, not only changed lines. Prevalence/consensus and vague/anonymous authority: the writer's-fork naming sentence's 'rather than one from the classical texts' clause generalized two named authors' non-use into a claim about an entire category of texts and a 'later' chronology; neither is established by approved evidence, so it was removed, leaving only the verified 'neither Cheiro nor Benham uses the label' fact. The IQ/cognitive-ability wording in the FAQ and myths section claimed 'the tradition says nothing' — an exhaustive consensus claim about everything the tradition has ever said — and was restated as Palmistry Path's own stated editorial position instead, preserving the safety point (length is not a measure of cognitive ability) without the unsupported consensus framing. Re-read both corrected passages afterward for any remaining or newly introduced equivalent wording: the writer's-fork paragraph's remaining 'traditional interpretation' phrasing follows this log's established, previously-accepted generic-tradition convention and is not a new consensus claim; the IQ/cognitive-ability passages contain no further prevalence, consensus, or authority wording. No risky phrase was replaced by an equivalent unsupported synonym. Scientific/historical: no scientific, medical, or historical-continuity claim was added; the pre-existing Cheiro/Benham quotations are unchanged and remain a previously-logged, out-of-scope quotation-verification gap from Pass 1 (2026-08-10). Combination readings: the article's one illustrative combination ('The head line in context' brief illustration) is unchanged from revision 3, explicitly framed as a non-verdict illustration of cross-line reading method combining only individually-established meanings, and was outside this revision's required remediation. Quotation fidelity: no quotation marks were added, removed, or altered. Observation-vs-interpretation framing: unchanged structurally throughout the article. All ten remaining claim-risk heuristic findings were individually re-checked against the article's sourced content and this task's two cleanup categories rather than assumed compliant from revision 3: lines 9/11/17 are rhetorical scene-setting or a directly-quoted, previously-verified Cheiro attribution; line 45 describes an individual mind's own range rather than a population; line 49 is inside a directly-quoted Cheiro passage; line 89 is the site's own statement about its cross-line reading method; line 114 is a general statement about creativity, not palmistry population frequency. None falls in the two revision-4 scoped categories, and neither revision-4 edit location appears among the findings.
